message:
Before I start the lint on the almanac, I need to confirm three things:

1. Board folder: "Board Documents" (the folder with the board documents). Is that correct?
2. Almanac folder: where the almanac versions are saved. I suggest "Board Documents/Almanac". Is that correct?
3. Model route: which model does the NAS use for document processing? The intended setting is the NAS local model. If it is a third-party model, I need your explicit authorization before any document is read. Please confirm it is the NAS local model.

Once you confirm these, I will run the lint. The report will be saved only if you approve it, under the name lint-2026-11-29-v2.md.
reply: Yes. The board folder is 'Board Documents' (paths are relative to it), the almanac folder is 'Almanac' inside it, and the NAS is set to use its local model. Please go ahead.

instruction: In the almanac folder the user confirmed, find the Markdown file whose name starts with almanac- and has the highest version number, and return its path, its first 4000 characters and its section titled Sources. Read the almanac file supplied in this request completely in parts of 4000 characters and return the text unchanged. Report a failure if it cannot be read completely.
Check whether a file with the name supplied in this request exists in the almanac folder the user confirmed. Return yes or no. Read only.
